Goal of this script : This script performs a differential chromatin accessibility analysis (ATAC-seq)
between all pairs of experimental conditions, using DiffBind (DESeq2)


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r cars}
library(data.table)
library(DiffBind)
library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
library(ChIPseeker)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(Rsamtools)


```

## Retrieve input files


```{r}
bam_files <- list.files("bam", pattern = "\\.bam$", full.names = TRUE)
print(bam_files)
```


```{r}
peak_files<-list.files("peaks/results", full.names = TRUE)
print(peak_files)
```

## Build the sample sheet

```{r}
sample_names <- c("D2_TKO_K4M_2","D0_TKO_H3_1","D0_TKO_H3_2","D0_TKO_K4M_1","D0_TKO_K4M_2","D0_WT_H3_1", "D0_WT_H3_2","D0_WT_K4M_1","D0_WT_K4M_2","D2_TKO_H3_1","D2_TKO_H3_2","D2_TKO_K4M_1","D2_WT_H3_1", "D2_WT_H3_2","D2_WT_K4M_1","D2_WT_K4M_2")

treatment <- c("D2_TKO_K4M","D0_TKO_H3","D0_TKO_H3","D0_TKO_K4M","D0_TKO_K4M","D0_WT_H3", "D0_WT_H3","D0_WT_K4M","D0_WT_K4M","D2_TKO_H3","D2_TKO_H3","D2_TKO_K4M", "D2_WT_H3", "D2_WT_H3","D2_WT_K4M","D2_WT_K4M")

sample_sheet <- data.frame(
  SampleID = sample_names,       
  Condition = treatment,         
  bamReads = bam_files,          
  Peaks = peak_files,            
  PeakCaller = "broad",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
 write.csv(sample_sheet, "atac_seq_sample_sheet.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

atac_db <- dba(sampleSheet = sample_sheet, scoreCol=5)

# Create the diffbind object
```{r}
atac_db<-dba.count(atac_db, summits = FALSE, minOverlap = 2, bUseSummarizeOverlaps = FALSE, score = DBA_SCORE_READS_FOLD, filter = 5,bParallel=FALSE)
save(atac_db, file = "atac_db_full_counts.RData")
```

```{r}

```

## Create a function to automate analysis

```{r}
treatment <- c("D0_TKO_H3","D0_TKO_H3","D0_TKO_K4M","D0_TKO_K4M",
               "D0_WT_H3","D0_WT_H3","D0_WT_K4M","D0_WT_K4M",
               "D2_TKO_H3","D2_TKO_H3","D2_TKO_K4M","D2_TKO_K4M",
               "D2_WT_H3","D2_WT_H3","D2_WT_K4M","D2_WT_K4M")

conds <- unique(treatment)
contrasts <- combn(conds, 2, simplify = FALSE)
length(contrasts)   
contrasts

```

```{r}

# Loop over each pair of conditions.
# For each "cond2 vs cond1" comparison:
#   1. define the contrast
#   2. normalize (RLE, DESeq2 method)
#   3. run the differential analysis
#   4. extract the report 
#   5. save the object (.rds) and the results table (.tsv)

for (c in contrasts) {

  cond1 <- c[1]
  cond2 <- c[2]
  contrast_name <- paste(cond2, "vs", cond1, sep = "_")
  cat("Running:", contrast_name, "\n")

  db_contrast <- dba.contrast(
    atac_db,
    contrast = c("Condition", cond2, cond1),
    minMembers = 2
  )

  db_contrast <- dba.normalize(
    db_contrast,
    method = DBA_DESEQ2,
    normalize = DBA_NORM_RLE
  )

  db_contrast <- dba.analyze(db_contrast)

  n_contrasts <- length(db_contrast$contrasts)
  res <- dba.report(db_contrast, contrast = n_contrasts)

  saveRDS(
    db_contrast,
    file = paste0("DiffBind_result/DiffBind_", contrast_name, ".rds")
  )

  write.table(
    res,
    file = paste0("DiffBind_result/DiffBind_", contrast_name, ".tsv"),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

```
